channels.name: Google Business Profile
channels.note: Ranks IIS in Maps + local pack for "IT support near me" across every service city.

channels.name: Bing Places for Business
channels.note: Feeds Copilot and Bing AI answers — cheap incremental reach.

channels.name: Microsoft Partner Center → Solutions Partner directory
channels.note: Free listing in the Microsoft find-a-partner directory. Buyer intent is extremely high.

channels.name: Azure Marketplace — consulting service listing
channels.note: List a fixed-scope M365/Azure assessment as a free consulting offer. Global distribution, no fee.

channels.name: AWS Partner Network + Marketplace
channels.note: Partner locator listing; adds credibility for cloud RFPs.

channels.name: Clutch
channels.note: Buyers shortlist MSPs here. Verified reviews compound; free profile.

channels.name: G2 — service provider profile
channels.note: Free vendor profile; reviews carry into AI search results.

channels.name: GoodFirms / The Manifest / DesignRush
channels.note: Three free listings, one capability blurb. Backlinks + referral traffic.

channels.name: Cloudtango — MSP directory
channels.note: MSP-specific, global, free. Buyers filter by country + service.

channels.name: UpCity + Expertise.com
channels.note: Free listings; local SEO value in each metro.

channels.name: LinkedIn Company Page + Services tab
channels.note: Services tab makes IIS appear in LinkedIn service-provider search. Free and under-used.

channels.name: Crunchbase + Owler company profiles
channels.note: Feeds enrichment tools and AI models; makes IIS resolvable as an entity.

channels.name: Canadian Company Capabilities (ISED)
channels.note: Free federal directory; Trade Commissioner Service pulls leads from it for export matchmaking.

channels.name: Trade Commissioner Service (Canada)
channels.note: Free introductions to foreign buyers + local partners in 160 cities. This is the onsite-resource pipeline.

channels.name: Wikidata + schema.org Organization markup on iisupp.net
channels.note: Makes IIS a known entity to LLM answer engines — the new front page.

channels.name: GitHub org — publish free IT tooling/scripts
channels.note: Open-source a few genuinely useful admin scripts. Free authority, inbound developer traffic.

channels.name: YouTube + short-form: one fix, one video
channels.note: Every support ticket resolved is a 90-second video. Evergreen inbound, zero cost.

channels.name: Trustpilot
channels.note: Free profile; review velocity is the cheapest conversion lift available.
